Pipeline_max_export_ig: ligo brick ig export (processes/ligo's exportInstanceGroupFromZone) — zonematerial/zonespecial export every distinct (lowercased) ig name in the file like the standalone ig process; zonetransition exports one ig per grid slot (0..8), selecting only nodes whose ig name matches that exact slot's zoneBaseName and repositioning them via a new buildTransitionMatrixObj (recenters the pivot at the cell center before mirror/rotate, composes as mt·copyMt — distinct from zone's buildTransitionMatrix, which repositions the RklPatch's own vertices). New --ligo <outdir> [--cellsize 160] mode; RklPatch grid-slot validity gated by classifyTransitionGrid, using CRklPatchObject's own (pre-modifier) patch verts for the bbox center — sufficient for 160m-cell classification without duplicating zone's full NeL Edit/Paint modifier-stack evaluation. Corpus caught two real bugs: the zonematerial/zonespecial branch compared a lowercased scan key against un-lowercased per-node ig names, silently dropping every node whose own ig-name tag used different casing than its group's canonical form (68 streetlights vanished from one ig before the fix); and the harness omitted --ps-path, so every clusterize FX-instance test fell back to the placeholder-mesh bbox instead of the real .ps shape's. New ligo_ig_corpus.py (mirrors zone_corpus.py's enumeration, ig_corpus.py's compare) gates against ~/pipeline_export/ecosystems/<eco>/ligo_es/igs: T1/T2 1201/1201, T3 537 igs produced (matches the reference count exactly), 448/537 (83%) match or uninit-bytes-only under the established mask. Two open, budgeted diff classes (DIFF_BUDGET=89, not silently passed): a selection-order divergence on a handful of files (same instance count/name set, different sequence — same open-issue class as shape's "candide" note) and a few accelerator cluster-membership edge cases on borderline meshes. Wired as ctest pipeline_max_ligo_ig_corpus (self-skip 77); full 9-test pipeline_max ctest suite green.
